note: Laramie County's RV campground at the Archer Complex (fairgrounds and event center) on Cheyenne's east edge, open to travelers as well as event-goers. Sites are assigned by the office after booking. No tents. The nearest dump station is at the Wyoming Welcome Center off I-25. --Claude
